images.caption:
Map of battlefield core and study areas.
The revised Study Area includes the Federal approach route from their supply base at Pleasant Hill and the Confederate approach route from their camps in Mansfield. Both forces were aware of the presence of the other and left that morning anticipating an engagement.

The Core Area was expanded to include the Confederate line of battle just south of Mansfield and the Federal rear guard action on the retreat toward Pleasant Hill.

images.caption:
Illustration for Vol 18. of Frank Leslie's Illustrated Newspaper
The Battle of Mansfield, Louisiana. The War in Louisiana- Battle of Mansfield, between Gen. Banks and General Dick Taylor, April 8, 1864


The Battle of Mansfield, also known as the Battle of Sabine Crossroads, occurred on April 8, 1864, in DeSoto Parish, Louisiana.
